disease_label_per_paper: Candida auris candidemia after traumatic brain injury, VP shunt, and PICC line for TPN
presentation_summary: Previously immunocompetent 61-year-old man admitted after traumatic brain injury, prolonged surgical ICU stay, mechanical ventilation, tracheostomy, VP shunt, and PICC for TPN.
Nine days into hospitalization he developed worsening fevers up to 101.7 F with concern for VP shunt infection and CSF leak.
PICC was discontinued and broad-spectrum antibiotics were started; Candida was identified in blood culture as Candida auris, with sensitivity to micafungin.
